# Technical Assistant
1. Your direct superior is the Chief Engineer, but you are expected to follow the orders of your designated trainer.
2. Technical Assistants are to work with the Chief Engineer, an Atmospheric Technician, or a Station Engineer to get on-the-job training.
3. Once trained, Technical Assistants may perform simple duties such as setting up of the AME or deploying the solar panels.
4. Technical Assistants may assist in any normal station repairs but must be closely supervised during any power generation duties.
5. Technical Assistants may not make major station renovations or changes without direct supervision.
